children: WEC Energy Group presented its September 2026 investor update highlighting a $37.5 billion 2026-2030 capital plan supporting 7.0%-8.0% long-term EPS growth and continued dividend increases.
$37.5B 2026–2030 capital plan focused on transmission, distribution, generation and LNG to support 7–8% EPS CAGR.
Company expects 2026 guidance midpoint EPS ~$5.56 and targets long-term EPS growth of 7.0%–8.0%.
Raised dividend in January to an annualized $3.81; 23rd consecutive year of dividend increases and target 6.5%–7% dividend growth.
Point Beach PPA extended with NextEra (units extended to 2050/2053), aimed at customer savings and price certainty pending PSCW approval.
Wisconsin and Illinois rate cases progressing: proposed 2027 base rate increases and VLC tariff approved to serve very large customers.
